feeds.what: every contest of the election in one document (453 ballot items: federal, state, General Assembly, city & town, state and local questions), with summary results and vote-method groups
feeds.notes: Standard Enhanced Voting shape: …/results/public/api/elections/<slug>/<election id>/data. Slug is case-insensitive here (rhodeisland; the jurisdiction shortName is RhodeIsland). cache-control: public, max-age=60. Served brotli-compressed (57 KB on the wire).

feeds.what: jurisdiction document, including the list of 11 elections (publicElectionId, electionDate, name)
feeds.notes: The 'elections' array is the elections list. …/api/elections/rhodeisland (the path the brief suggested) is 404 here.

feeds.what: media export: the whole election with precinct-level breakdown, plain names and numbers
feeds.notes: 11.1 MB, so only the first 1 MB is kept (it is cut mid-document and will not parse). URL is <site>/cdn/results/<jurisdiction.mediaExportPath>; the path comes from the 'mediaExportPath' field of the data/jurisdiction documents and the '/cdn/results' base from the site's JS environment. Last-Modified: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 21:41:03 GMT, Cache-Control: public, max-age=60, served as application/octet-stream. Simpler shape than /data: results.ballotItems[].{type,id,name,voteFor,contestType,ballotOptions[].{name,voteCount,politicalParty,groupResults}}. No cut-outs made because data.json already holds every contest whole.

election_id: 2026StatewideGeneralElection (publicElectionId); last path segment of the page URL and second-to-last of the data URL. Jurisdiction slug: rhodeisland.
discovery: GET https://electionresults.ri.gov/results/public/api/jurisdictions/rhodeisland and read elections[] (publicElectionId + electionDate, newest first). Ids are hand-named and not predictable (2026StatewideGeneralElection, RI2026StatewidePrimary, febspec26, decspec25).
cors: *  (access-control-allow-origin: * on the data API, the jurisdictions API and the CDN export)
bot_blocking: None. Relay User-Agent got 200 on everything (Azure Front Door, no challenge). Browser User-Agent not needed, not tried.
updated_field: election.asOf = "2026-11-10T21:40:56.3074467Z" (UTC, ISO 8601 with Z); also election.lastUpdated "2026-11-10T21:31:17.6801627Z", election.publishDate "2026-11-10T21:41:01.4350547Z", and per contest ballotItems[].reportingStatus.asOf. In the media export: createdAt.
reporting_field: Per contest: ballotItems[].reportingStatus.reportingUnits / totalUnits, e.g. Governor {"reportingUnits":39,"totalUnits":39} (units are cities/towns here: reportingStatusBy = 1, precinctsReporting is null). Per town: jurisdiction.childLocalities[].percentReporting (e.g. 0.8333333). election.groupReportingStatus gives status per count group (Election Day, Early Voting, Mail Ballots).
choice_format: Party is inside the name and also a separate object: name [{"languageId":"en","text":"John F. Reed (DEM)"}], party.abbreviation "DEM", voteCount 240686. Independents are "Kenneth Block (Ind)" with abbreviation "Ind". Write-ins are one option named "Write-in" with party null. Measures: contestType "BallotMeasure", options "Approve" and "Reject" (party abbreviation "NON"). Local contests are prefixed with the town: "Barrington: Town Council".
district_field: Only in the title ("… District 1", not zero-padded). No separate district field; contestGroupId maps to election.contestGroups (Federal, State, General Assembly, City & Town, State Questions, Local Questions).
terms: none found (no terms-of-use text in the page or in the data document's clientTexts beyond result disclaimers).
tried: https://www.ri.gov/election/results/2026/general_election/ (the pre-2025 home of RI results): 404; the 2024 path still answers 200, so the old site was not carried forward
Read main-*.js to find the media export base (/cdn/results) and fetched the export: 200, 11.1 MB
